record.name: Poisson / negative binomial exposure regression

record.inputs: Raw regional counts, per-cell exposure, matched regions, cluster covariate, callable span
record.outputs: Relative rate ratios, uncertainty and predictive zero rates
record.mechanism: log mean = log exposure + region effect + covariates; NB dispersion accommodates extra-Poisson variability
record.reference_requirements: Relative controls; no assumed diploid reference; absolute CN needs independent anchor
record.low_coverage_handling: Zeros are measured counts; estimate predictive zero fraction conditional on exposure
record.homozygous_deletion: Not identifiable from zeros alone

record.name: Phase-aware beta-binomial allele model
record.assay: Numbat published for scRNA; proposed transfer to scATAC
record.inputs: Phased allele observations and total allele counts, phase-set confidence, bias controls
record.outputs: Haplotype fraction with interval and power against a specified imbalance; no allele data means no inference
record.mechanism: Beta-binomial for counts given total with overdispersion; phase-switch error and heterogeneous mixtures require explicit modeling
record.reference_requirements: No normal assumption for relative imbalance; calibrated baseline and SNP ascertainment remain necessary
record.low_coverage_handling: AT=0 gives no allele-fraction information; finite counts yield wide uncertainty
record.homozygous_deletion: Cannot identify 0:0 from allele fraction without independent dosage evidence

record.name: Hurdle, zero-inflated NB or latent count mixtures
record.inputs: Same raw-count inputs and fitted baseline; technical controls and replicated datasets
record.outputs: Predictive distribution and latent mixture uncertainty, not biological deletion classification
record.mechanism: Separate probability of zero or mixture component; assess held-out predictions and model-based calibration
record.reference_requirements: Component labels need external biological validation and identifiability
record.low_coverage_handling: Extra zeros depend on the null model; small means and heterogeneity can mimic a zero component
record.homozygous_deletion: A zero component is not proof of biallelic loss
record.evidence: Zero-inflation evidence shown in scRNA; mixture asymptotic issues general
record.fit: Consider only after baseline checks identify systematic misfit
limitations: Boundary and unidentified parameters invalidate naive chi-square LRT
Component instability and count confounding
No orthogonal truth
